prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry and company stage. I can narrow it down for you if you tell me more about what you need.  

How to pick the best agency for your situation
- Define the goal: performance (paid media/lead gen), SEO, content/social, brand/creative, product/UX growth, or full-funnel strategy.  
- Match experience: look for case studies and clients in your industry and similar company size.  
- Check outcomes, not awards: ask for KPIs, ROI examples, and the measurement approach.  
- Team and culture fit: who will actually do the work — senior strategists or juniors? Communication cadence?  
- Budget and timeline: some shops do retainers, others are project- or performance-based.  
- References and transparency: ask for client references and examples of real reporting/dashboards.  

Reliable places to research agencies
- Clutch, G2, UpCity, Agency Spotter for ratings and verified reviews  
- LinkedIn and Google Reviews for customer feedback  
- Ask peers or local startup founders for referrals (meetups, Slack groups)

Examples of well-regarded agencies with San Francisco presence (by specialty)
- Large digital/brand/experience: R/GA, AKQA, Huge, Goodby Silverstein & Partners — strong for brand, creative and complex digital experiences.  
- Performance/paid media & growth: look for boutique growth agencies or US arms of national performance shops (search “performance marketing San Francisco” on Clutch/G2 to see up-to-date leaders).  
- SEO & content: many specialized firms and freelancers in SF; prioritize agencies with transparent reporting and documented organic growth results.  
- B2B SaaS / Demand Gen: search for agencies with case studies in SaaS lead generation and account-based marketing.

If you want a specific recommendation, tell me:
- Your industry and company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)  
- Primary goals (brand, traffic, leads, conversions, app installs)  
- Monthly budget or expected spend (retainer or media budget)  
I’ll suggest 3–5 agencies in San Francisco that match your needs and include the strengths and what to ask them in an initial call.
